guard: the real published CLI reconciles bundled Agent Skills on normal startup and through cotal update
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm --filter cotal-ai build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/agent-skills-entry.smoke.ts

mutations.name: remove the normal-startup Agent Skills hook
mutations.find: if (argv[0] !== "setup") installAgentSkills(); // setup reconciles inside its own flow so provenance sees the actual install/refresh
mutations.replace: if (false && argv[0] !== "setup") installAgentSkills(); // setup reconciles inside its own flow so provenance sees the actual install/refresh
mutations.expectRed: FIRST NORMAL COMMAND: fresh install generation appears
mutations.cell: FIRST NORMAL COMMAND: fresh install generation appears
mutations.note: Restores the explicit-setup-only defect: connector seeding still runs, but no cross-harness skill appears on first normal use.

mutations.name: remove the explicit update Agent Skills hook
mutations.expectRed: UPDATE COMMAND: explicit update reconciles bundled Agent Skills
mutations.cell: UPDATE COMMAND: explicit update reconciles bundled Agent Skills
mutations.note: The update entry must own an explicit skill reconciliation because boot deliberately skips update to avoid duplicate passes.

mutations.name: restore the setup double-reconcile that erases install provenance
mutations.find: if (argv[0] !== "setup") installAgentSkills(); // setup reconciles inside its own flow so provenance sees the actual install/refresh
mutations.expectRed: SETUP COMMAND: setup owns one skill reconcile and preserves install provenance
mutations.cell: SETUP COMMAND: setup owns one skill reconcile and preserves install provenance
mutations.note: Without the setup guard, boot installs the skill first and setup sees a no-op, reporting zero installed skills and losing the write provenance.
